title: The Collective Partners tab says partners are not available yet instead of failing when the partners table cannot be read

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: SCAN-982 shows the Partners tab on every collective and nonprofit_collective Space, and its row records that migration 20270346009200 (collective_partners) was not applied. The page called loadPartnersView with no catch, and partnershipRows throws 'Collective partners unavailable' when the read errors, so every Collective's Partners tab returned a 500 until the migration lands, and the calendar's month action threw the same way. The other readers already fail closed (livePartnerSpaceIds, the cross-listing page). The page now logs and renders an empty state when the view cannot be read, the shared calendar falls back to no events, and the month action logs and returns an empty month.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/partners/page.tsx','utf8'),a=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/partners/actions.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/loadPartnersView\\(hub\\.id\\)\\.catch\\(/.test(p))bad.push('the Partners page throws when the partners table cannot be read');if(!/try\\s*\\{[\\s\\S]*loadPartnersView[\\s\\S]*\\}\\s*catch/.test(a))bad.push('the partners month action throws when the partners table cannot be read');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1000: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
